sources.snippet: Model Repository Relevant source files The Model Repository is a system within Kraken that provides access to a collection of pre-trained OCR and HTR models. It allows users to discover, retrieve, and publish models through both a command-line interface and programmatic API.

sources.snippet: Training German Handwriting - UB-Mannheim/kraken GitHub Wiki Training of kraken model for German handwriting german_handwriting is a model which was trained for the recognition of handwritten (German) texts. The first training used 4 ground truth data sets. A 2nd training added another data set, and the 3rd training added one more again.
